tasks.task: For client WZP482 (user_id: zui_usr_01J3G0QYVQ7H7P8B2X6D2A9H8R), we need an end-of-day risk note without re-authentication: pull the latest persisted (non-refresh) holdings, positions, and margins snapshots and report the total equity net margin and any open net positions. Constraint: do not initiate a new Zerodha login or call any refresh endpoints because the user hasn’t completed re-login and we must avoid UNAUTHORIZED errors before today’s 6pm cut-off.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns a holdings snapshot with snapshot.snapshot_type == "holdings" for user_id zui_usr_01J3G0QYVQ7H7P8B2X6D2A9H8R.
Step 1 returns a positions snapshot with snapshot.snapshot_type == "positions" for the same user_id and includes payload.data.net positions (e.g., SBIN MIS and RELIANCE CNC).
Step 2 returns a margins snapshot with snapshot.snapshot_type == "margins" and includes payload.data.equity.net (e.g., 214532.7) for the same user_id.
No tool call in the chain uses refresh=true or requires a newly authenticated session (i.e., the chain should not hit UNAUTHORIZED due to login_initiated status).
